description: Work out how many sales a month a business needs to cover its costs, and how many to hit a target profit. Answers "what is my break-even point?" from fixed monthly costs, price per sale and variable cost per sale.

fixedCostsPerMonth.description: Monthly fixed costs: rent, salaries, software, anything paid whether or not you sell.

targetProfitPerMonth.description: Monthly profit to aim past break-even. Optional.

variableCostPerSale.description: What one sale costs to deliver.

name: forge_break_even
